articles.title: Angels To Trade Chase Silseth, Logan O'Hoppe To Rangers - MLB Trade Rumors
articles.description: The Angels and Rangers line up on an intra-division trade to kick off deadline week. Read more about the surprise move at MLB Trade Rumors.
articles.content:
The Angels and Rangers announced an intra-division trade on Wednesday evening. Texas acquired reliever Chase Silseth and catcher Logan O’Hoppe in exchange for infield prospect Angel Arredondo.
